site.bio:
Reforged and ready for the next era, Horsham-based Producer-Rapper and DJ GLucak is now gearing up toward his third album, IDENTITY, due August 13th of 2027. Making energetic, misfit, honest, Faith-based tracks since 2022, the EDM/Rap hybrid artist has been moving at a fast pace since then, having put together seven brand-new singles since his self-titled album debuted in 2025, beginning with Earned Your Stripes, and soon to conclude the series with Welcome Home.

Shortly afterward, a new era will begin. Deeper lyrical themes, further expansion of an already-versatile sound, and a bolder, louder approach than ever before. Nevertheless, the slogan is still the same as it was in ’22: Rise. Live It Loud. Push Past Fear. The Time Is Now.
